# Skillshare

> Online learning community offering creative classes taught by industry professionals, with tools for individual creators and enterprise team learning.

Skillshare connects creative professionals and learners through thousands of classes in design, illustration, video editing, and more. The platform supports both individual creators who want to teach and earn, as well as enterprise teams seeking professional development in creative skills and AI.

## Key Topics

- Creative education
- Online teaching platform
- Procreate
- DaVinci Resolve
- Blender
- Video editing
- Illustration
- Design
- Enterprise learning
- Team development
- Creator economy
- AI training
- Teacher community
- Professional development

## Teaching & Creator Resources

- [Skillshare](https://www.skillshare.com/en/teach): Teacher signup page for creators to teach classes on Skillshare platform

## Enterprise & Teams

- [Skillshare for Teams](https://www.skillshare.com/en/teams): Enterprise solution for team learning with creative classes and AI training
